name: Kariwa (Japan)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and brown, with a black outlined stylised character on the green band at the hoist and a white letter K on the yellow band.
history: Municipal flag of Kariwa, a village in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 16 April 1959; the emblem dates from 12 November 1951.

features.role: outlined stylised character at the upper hoist
letter K at the centre of the yellow band
